thread:
maria: Heads-up — we need to shift tomorrow's maintenance window for the EU serving cluster by 45 minutes due to a vendor confirmation delay. New window: 2026-03-16 03:15–04:15 UTC (was 02:30–03:30). Posting here before we hit the status page and support broadcast.
ashok: ack, thanks for the ping. Any customer-facing change in scope?
maria: No functional scope change — still OS patch + rolling restart of a subset of serving nodes. Impact: transient request throttling observed for heavy prefix workloads, best-effort failover to other regions. Estimated max degradation window per node ~90s during restart.
ashok: ok - oncall will be paged if we see errors spike during shift. I'll update the on-call checklist with the new times. @oncall-bot can you schedule a reminder 30m before start for the oncall?
oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled for 2026-03-16T02:45:00Z for team "eng-oncall". Auto-note: include runbook link: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/serving-node-restart>.
maria: drafting the status page update now. Proposed short status copy below — please sanity-check: 
```
Scheduled maintenance: EU serving cluster (rolling restarts) — window adjusted
We have adjusted the maintenance window for rolling restarts on the EU serving cluster. New window: 03/16 03:15–04:15 UTC. During the maintenance we may observe brief request throttling for a subset of customers. Services will automatically fail over where capacity permits. No data plane changes expected.
For updates: https://status.redwood.ai
```
ops-bot: deploy note: maintenance-notice v2 queued to status page. Preview link: https://status.redwood.ai/preview/1935678901
support-lead: thanks — I'll prepare an outbound email/DM template for customers in impacted regions. Draft: 
```
Subject: Update: Maintenance window adjusted for EU serving cluster
Hi <Customer>,
We wanted to let you know we've updated the timing for a planned maintenance affecting EU-serving endpoints. New window: 16 Mar 2026, 03:15–04:15 UTC. You may see brief increases in latency or rate-limited errors for a small fraction of requests while we restart nodes. No action required on your side. We'll post live updates on our status page and follow up when complete.
Regards, Redwood Inference Support
```
ashok: good. Also add this to the internal incident template so support triage can quickly classify incoming tickets as "maintenance-related". Use tag `#maintenance-eu-03-16`.
maria: done — added tag and a short FAQ snippet for support: "If a customer reports a 429/503 between 03:15–03:30 UTC, confirm request timestamp and advise automatic retries; escalate only if widespread or persists >10 minutes."
jordan: FYI I'll be taking on-call at 04:00 UTC, so if anything stretches past 04:00 please hand off. If the maintenance completes early, ping me and I'll take the handback.
ashok: noted. If schedule slips further I'll re-evaluate and we may pull in additional SRE.
sre-lead: quick ask — can we enable a temporary routing fallback to the US pool for high-latency prefixes to reduce customer impact? Maria/infra team, is that feasible without breaking affinity?
maria: yes, we can enable cross-region fallback policy for a short window. I'll coordinate with infra to toggle at start and revert after completion. Impact note: may increase tail latency for affected sessions but reduces error rate.
ops-bot: action: enable-cross-region-fallback scheduled at 2026-03-16T03:15:00Z, revert at 2026-03-16T04:30:00Z. Operator: infra-runbooks.
oncall-bot: 30-minute reminder fired for eng-oncall.
ashok: small checklist for oncall during window: 1) watch 5xx/429/latency dashboards, 2) if >1% error uplift sustained for 5m, trigger canary rollback to previous routing, 3) alert support to pause mass outbound customer emails until we confirm impact.
support-lead: I'll hold the broadcast until we confirm telemetry after start. If we see clear customer-affecting errors, I'll send the prepared template.
ops-bot: status page updated: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/1935678901 (public note live).
maria: thanks all. I'll post a short 'maintenance starting' note 5 minutes before the window and a 'completed' notification when we finish.
(2026-03-16T03:16:22 UTC) ops-bot: maintenance started: rolling restart of EU serving nodes initiated.
(2026-03-16T03:28:05 UTC) oncall-bot: Alert triggered: elevated 429 rate in eu-serving-prod — 1.8% uplfit sustained for 6 minutes. Pager routed to eng-oncall (ashok).
ashok: investigating — checking node restarts and LB failover. Looks like two pods still cycling, ramping retries. Taking ownership.
sre-lead: suggest we enable the cross-region fallback now (per earlier plan) to reduce 429s.
maria: enabling fallback now.
ops-bot: action executed: cross-region-fallback enabled.
(2026-03-16T03:35:12 UTC) oncall-bot: 429 rate reduced to 0.4% after fallback — monitoring.
support-lead: can confirm incoming support volume is normal; no mass customer complaints yet. I'll keep inboxes monitored.
jordan: I'm ready to take handback at 04:00 if things are stable.
(2026-03-16T04:02:55 UTC) ops-bot: maintenance completed: rolling restart and fallback revert executed. Post-checks show all EU serving nodes healthy.
maria: maintenance complete — updating status page and sending completion note to impacted customers now. Completion note draft: 
```
Subject: Maintenance complete — EU serving cluster
Hi <Customer>,
Maintenance window for the EU serving cluster has completed. All services are reporting healthy. If you observe any lingering errors or latency, please reply and we will investigate. Thanks for your patience.
— Redwood Inference
```
ops-bot: status page update posted: incident 1935678901 marked resolved. Timeline available at https://status.redwood.ai/incident/1935678901/timeline
ashok: handing back to jordan for post-mortem actions and follow-up. Jordan, please check logs for any retries that might have caused client-side visible duplicate responses and file a short incident note if needed.
jordan: will do. I'll run a quick query for duplicate completions and circulate a 1-paragraph postmortem in #postmortems within 24h.
maria: thanks team. small retrospective item: update maintenance pre-check to include 'verify vendor confirmation 24h before' to avoid last-minute shifts.
sre-lead: noted and adding to retro list. :memo:
